description: Read your mail from a private cache without giving callers the mailbox password. Sync, list, search and read mail, set Seen status, and subscribe an agent to new mail. Start with sync, then list.
author: Serg Parf

limit.help: Maximum items, 1..100; defaults are stated per method

uid.help: Mailbox UID, 1..4294967295, never an IMAP command or sequence number

target.help: A queue or agent whose ACL admits this IMAP instance; the author must also be admitted

id.help: Subscription id returned by sub add

folder.help: --folder <name> (JSON folder) on every per-mail call; default is the configured mailbox, then INBOX.

uids.help: 123, 123,130 or 100:200, at most 1000 UIDs, with a per-UID result; duplicate UIDs refused

dest.help: Decoded existing selectable destination folder name from folders; never guessed

sync.help: Fetch mail not yet cached, newest first; default 100. Return progress and whether more remains; use list to see cached mail. A forwarding-state error blocks default-folder sync until rebaseline; read, list and search keep working. Per-folder cache keyed by folder and UIDVALIDITY; the existing single-mailbox cache becomes the default folder's cache with no re-sync.

list.help: See cached Date, From and Subject with live read/unread and a flags column, newest UID first; default 20. --unread and --flag <f> filter before the limit. Date is as sent, unverified.

args.name: flag
args.help: Require this live flag; JSON flag is a string

search.help: Server-side IMAP SEARCH: --from --to --subject --header Name:value --since --before --flag --no-flag --larger --smaller --limit, combined with AND. Free text stays local. Return cached matches, default 100; sync first to discover mail. Dates accept YYYY-MM-DD or DD-Mon-YYYY; JSON uses no_flag.

args.name: text
args.help: Local case-insensitive cache match, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, no controls

read.help: Get one raw mail and mark it Seen by default, cached or not. --no-mark (JSON mark_read:false) leaves it unchanged. Every read needs a live server; a lost reply may leave the mail marked. No other flags.

publish.help: Copy one raw mail, with an external-content warning, to the Configuration target. Each explicit repeat copies again.

help.help: Show the calls and their limits.

sub add.help: Forward mail that arrives after this add to a destination; the old backlog is never forwarded. A missing or empty filter matches ALL new mail in the selected folder. The author's permission to send is checked at add and on each forward, and the receiver must also admit this IMAP instance. At most 20 subscriptions per creator, 100 in total. --folder <name> (JSON folder) selects the subscription mailbox; omitted keeps the configured mailbox. Per-folder baseline and UIDVALIDITY; other folders never feed this subscription.

args.name: filter
args.help: Match sender addr-spec plus decoded subject; common regex subset, at most 200 characters, optional /imsu flags; no g/y

sub list.help: Review your subscriptions: folder, target, creator, filter, first UID and sent and dropped counts. Direct Owners and Maintainers see all, including damaged rows marked invalid_state for repair. No mailbox connection. A blank line separates the cached per-folder status lines at the end.

sub delete.help: Stop your subscription. Direct Owners and Maintainers may delete any subscription, including damaged rows. To change one, delete it and add it again; the new one starts at the current UIDNEXT.

status.help: Cached health, counts and one line per synced or subscribed folder, with IDLE or polling mode. No provider connection for status. Pre-step-5 synced folder names are recovered by a read-only LIST during the next normal mailbox connection.

mark.help: Set or clear Seen on the named UIDs and return a per-UID result. Ordinary IMAP admission permits this. An unknown write outcome is not retried.

folders.help: name and role (Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Trash, Junk, Archive); --counts adds total and unseen via STATUS.

args.name: counts
args.help: Add total and unseen counts; JSON counts is a boolean

flag.help: flagged, answered, draft, seen, a custom keyword; \Deleted refused. Ordinary admission; change only the named flags and return a per-UID observed result. Unknown writes are not retried.

args.name: action
args.help: Add or remove only the named flags

args.name: flags
args.help: One or more flags: flagged, answered, draft, seen or a custom keyword; JSON flags is an array

headers.help: All headers, with a per-UID result (no Seen). External content is untrusted; answer limited to 256 KiB.

parts.help: The MIME tree with id, type, size, filename, inline or attachment. Sizes are encoded bytes; no Seen.

part.help: Decoded, base64 for binary, 25 MB cap, no Seen. Refuse above 26214400 encoded bytes before decoding. Return what fits in the 256 KiB answer cap and label truncation.

args.name: part_id
args.help: MIME leaf id from parts, e.g. 1 or 2.1

copy.help: Copy the named UIDs to the destination and report new UIDs when supplied by the server. Source mail stays. Requires allow_destructive; each explicit repeat copies again.

move.help: MOVE, else copy + remove those UIDs only. Without MOVE or UIDPLUS it is refused before copying. A partial fallback reports copied, source kept and its new UID; unknown outcomes are never retried.

trash.help: Move to the role Trash; refused if none. Names are never guessed. Requires allow_destructive.

delete.help: Permanent: \Deleted + UID EXPUNGE of exactly those UIDs; refused without UIDPLUS. Requires allow_destructive. Gmail expunge in a label removes the label, not necessarily the message.

compact_trash.help: Empty only the Trash role folder, or its mail older than the UTC date boundary by INTERNALDATE. Exact UID expunge only; requires UIDPLUS and allow_destructive. At most 1000 matches; narrow older if more. JSON folder, if supplied, must be that Trash folder.

args.name: older
args.help: Days, 0..365000; filter before today minus this many days

folder create.help: Create a folder. Ordinary admission; not gated by allow_destructive.

args.name: name
args.help: Decoded folder name, modified UTF-7 quoted on the wire

folder rename.help: Rename a folder. Refuse INBOX, the configured mailbox and its ancestors (including subscribed mail). Requires allow_destructive.

folder delete.help: Delete a folder. Refuse INBOX, SPECIAL-USE role folders and their ancestors, and the configured mailbox and its ancestors. A non-empty folder requires --force; it never overrides these protections. Requires allow_destructive.

args.name: force
args.help: Permit deleting a non-empty unprotected folder

append.help: Append raw RFC 5322 text after the first newline (JSON raw). Report APPENDUID when supplied; otherwise explicitly report UID unavailable. Mail cap 25 MB; the existing 1048576-byte bus request cap including encoded JSON and envelope is lower. Requires allow_destructive; never retry an unknown write.

args.name: flags
args.help: Comma-separated flags; JSON also accepts an array. Deleted refused

mode.help: Implicit verified TLS by default; plain requires explicit loopback opt-out

auth.help: App password (default) or Google XOAUTH2; no fallback

mailbox.help: Mailbox or Gmail label, Unicode accepted; default INBOX

target.help: Optional fixed publication destination; required only for publish

cache_bytes.help: Logical cache byte budget including state/temporary writes; default 67108864, range 4194304..536870912

cafile.help: Optional existing public CA trust file visible inside the sandbox

allow_plaintext.help: Explicit opt-out permitting plain mode only to loopback; default false

allow_destructive.help: Per instance, off by default. Gates copy, move, trash, delete, compact_trash, folder rename/delete and append. Folder create, read, mark and flag stay under ordinary admission.
